newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus reverse repo auction yield at 5.73 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus reverse repo auction yield at 5.73 pct.

text.p: The average yield on a reverse repo auction of 14-day Cypriot bills was 5.73 percent on Wednesday, unchanged from the previous central bank auction on November 14.
Bids from commercial banks totalled 16 million pounds for the 10 million pounds worth of bills on offer by the Central Bank of Cyprus.
The highest accepted yield was 5.91 percent and the lowest 5.50 percent, the central bank said.
